confusions: kit/policy-templates.md and kit/catalogue.json do not include the rate_limiting recipe; the live `xano policy catalogue` does. I used the live CLI output.

No documented XanoScript form for attaching middleware to an endpoint; every form tried was refused ('Invalid kind for middleware', 'Invalid block'). The skill and catalogue say what the check reads but not how to attach it.
The recipe's login rule says 'login API group', but login lives in the shared 'app' group, so api_groups would cover the whole app. I used a tag instead.
Syntax of the middleware body (request headers and path variables, error types for a 429-style refusal) is not documented in the materials here; I guessed $request.headers and accessdenied.
